items.title: 11721 W 181ST Street, Overland Park, KS 66013
items.description: The stunning HAMILTON 1.5-story by Bickimer Homes is back in MODEL ROW due to high demand and ready to tour on lot #13 in Woodmyre in Overland Park, 181st/ Quivira. A must-see new model home with updated warm wood, black solid surface countertops, and an impressive daylight basement with a speakeasy twist that everyone is talking about. This spacious 1.5-story is a favorite with a main-floor primary bedroom and a sunroom/office or 5th bedroom option, high ceilings in the great room, a curved open staircase, and a bonus upstairs loft! WOW! Beautiful new English Contemporary exterior is fresh and timeless with stucco, light-colored stone, black window frames, and metal roof accents with an oversized iron entry door. WOODMYRE is one of the last new home communities in Johnson County. With only 85 homes when complete, WOODMYRE will provide an intimate, connected lifestyle in a thoughtfully designed and naturally inspired neighborhood you’ll be proud to call home! Located at 181st/Quivira, Woodmyre is close to Bluhawk shopping, OP Arboretum, Heritage Park, and has super easy access to HWY 69. BLUE VALLEY SCHOOLS Read more

items.title: 15268 W 161st Court, Olathe, KS 66062
items.description: The St. John by C3 Homes coming soon! This 1.5 Story home features main floor primary bedroom and additional main floor bedroom or office. Three bedrooms upstairs, all of which have their own private bathroom. Laundry on main level and upstairs. No more hauling laundry up and down the stairs! Unfinished basement with plumbing stub and daylight grade lot. This home is under construction! Renderings are for conceptual purposes only and specifications and features may vary. All in the coveted Heritage Ranch, A Lambie-Rieke Community, with Amenities Galore such as state-of-the-art pool, clubhouse, trails, pickleball, putting green, play area, half-court basketball, ponds and so much more coming soon! This community provides a wonderful lifestyle and right next to the 1,238 Acre Heritage Park with Dog Park, Sports Parks, Golf, Lake, Trails and so much more! Contact Onsite Agents for Estimated Completion of homes on site, and design selections. Our Welcome Center Office is located at LOT 64, open 7 days a week. Sq Ft & Taxes are estimated. Home is under construction. 60+/- Days to Completion. LOT 20. Welcome Home to Heritage Ranch - one of the last NEW Home Communities in Johnson County! Read more

items.title: 11704 W 181st Street, Overland Park, KS 66013
items.description: The Roosevelt 1.5 Story with Regency exterior elevation by Bickimer Homes on lot #8 in Woodmyre, an upscale new home community in OP with Blue Valley Schools, ready for a Fall 2027 move-in. This sought-after plan features a stunning circular staircase as you enter, arched room transitions, an upstairs loft space, a grand two-story great room and a secret back pantry with access from the garage to the back yard. The most talked about model home is now back and building in Woodmyre. There is still time to pick your design selections and add a basement finish. *Photos of previous model home as this home is under construction* Woodmyre is a brand new upscale new home community in Overland Park with BLUE VALLEY SCHOOLS. Situated on a hilltop at 181st and Quivira this boutique style community will have a resort-style pool, year round outdoor covered pavilion, pickleball court, play area, basketball half court, and outdoor sports field. With only 85 homes when complete, WOODMYRE will provide an intimate, connected lifestyle thoughtfully designed by 4 local builders and naturally inspired by the wooded hilltop. A neighborhood you’ll be proud to call home! Located at 181st/Quivira, Woodmyre is close to Bluhawk shopping, OP Arboretum, Heritage Park with easy access to HWY 69. BLUE VALLEY SCHOOLS Read more

items.title: 3440 W 133rd Terrace, Leawood, KS 66209
items.description: Willis Custom Homes presents the Bradford Cottage for East Village Leawood! Located on Lot 8, this Reverse 1.5 Story home offers thoughtful design throughout for everyday living. The main level features a spacious kitchen and dining that make entertaining easy, from the large kitchen island and walk-in pantry to the built-in hutch in the dining area. A large covered lanai with fireplace is the perfect place to relax! The main level primary suite is a spa-like space, and the spacious flex room is perfect for an additional bedroom or office on the main as well. Two bedrooms, bar, rec, and bath complete the lower level. Construction is scheduled to be complete on 9/4/26! East Village Leawood is one of Leawood's newest maintenance-provided communities conveniently located off the 135th St corridor. Uncover everything East Village Leawood has to offer in this amazing mixed-use community designed by Oddo Development Company, Inc. Residential meets vibrant living experience unlike any other community in South Johnson County! Read more

items.title: 17341 W 169th Terrace, Olathe, KS 66062
items.description: ***The Makenna by Gabriel Homes***Lot 137***MODEL NOW FOR SALE*** Beautiful Boulder Creek! You won't want to miss this new and stunning modern Makenna model home by Gabriel Homes that is outfitted with so many custom features and designer decor! This 4 bedroom & 3.5 bath home features an open concept kitchen/breakfast room/great room with 10 ft ceilings plus a main floor office just off the entry with French doors and built-in bookshelves. HUGE master bedroom with a sitting room for your quiet get-away. An amazing master bathroom with 3 shower heads, free-standing tub, a huge walk-in closet plus a second walk-in closet behind a SECRET DOOR. 2nd floor laundry room adjacent to the master bedroom. Covered stamped concrete patio plus more open-air patio with a firepit. This home is a must see!!! Read more

items.title: 7927 Round Prairie Street, Shawnee, KS 66220
items.description: MODEL HOME – NOT FOR SALE. Welcome to the Cypress by J.S. Robinson Fine Homes on Lot 79 in Bristol Highlands. J.S. Robinson shows off their craft in this stunning new 1.5 Story model, the Gold Pick of the Parade! This home has all the right spaces in all the right places—starting with a main-level primary suite that feels like a retreat with its soaking tub, separate shower, and double vanity. The laundry room connects directly to the oversized walk-in closet (complete with built-ins), keeping life organized is easier than ever. The heart of the home is a 2-story great room drenched in natural light with a cozy gas fireplace, while a flex room with glass-paned double sliding pocket doors gives you space for an office, playroom, or creative nook right off the breakfast area. The kitchen is as stylish as it is functional, featuring cabinets to the ceiling, a quartz-topped oversized island, and a generous walk-in pantry. A large mudroom ties the flow together, leading out to the 3-car garage. Upstairs, zoned heating and cooling keep everyone comfortable. The spacious loft with a walk-in closet is already roughed in for a future bathroom, while three bedrooms offer private and shared spaces—one ensuite with its own bath, and two sharing a Jack-and-Jill with separate vanities. Future amenities include a clubhouse, resort-style pool, play area, sport courts, and more! Located in a premier Shawnee location close to parks, trails, shopping, dining and top-rated De Soto schools, all 5 minutes from Shawnee Mission Park (largest park in JoCo), Lake Lenexa, 7 premier golf courses, Lenexa City Center and Marketplace with the new Restaurant Row plus the numerous festivals in Shawnee and Lenexa throughout the year! Open Daily! Read more

items.title: 11717 W 181st Street, Overland Park, KS 66013
items.description: The brand NEW MAPLEWOOD IV REVERSE by JFE HOMES is now finished and ready to tour in WOODMYRE on lot #14. This stunning MODEL HOME is an expanded version of the popular Maplewood with all the extra features like a back hall, prep-style kitchen pantry, large dining room, tall ceilings, arched entries, covered deck, and a bonus spectacular finished basement featuring a golf simulator. WOW! WOODMYRE is one of the last new home communities in Johnson County. With only 85 homes when complete, WOODMYRE will provide an intimate, connected lifestyle in a thoughtfully designed and naturally inspired neighborhood you’ll be proud to call home! Located at 181st/Quivira, Woodmyre is close to Bluhawk shopping, OP Arboretum, Heritage Park, and has super easy access to HWY 69. BLUE VALLEY SCHOOLS * MODEL HOME NOT FOR SALE* Due to a road closure, please travel South on Pflumm to 183rd, just past Riverstone, to visit us. Read more

items.title: 3256 W 133rd Terrace, Leawood, KS 66209
items.description: Model Now for Sale! Discover the perfect balance of contemporary design and comfortable living in this stunning Willis Custom Homes Reverse 1.5-story home. From the moment you step through the smart glass double front doors, you’re greeted by soaring ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an abundance of natural light that flows seamlessly through the open main level. The floating staircase and offset fireplace serve as striking architectural centerpieces, while thoughtfully designed ambient lighting enhances the home’s warm and modern aesthetic. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream — featuring solid surface countertops, custom cabinetry, and high-end appliances, all crafted for both functionality and entertaining. With 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, this home offers flexible living spaces ideal for families or guests. The walkout, walk-up lower level expands your living area outdoors, opening to a beautifully landscaped backyard where a tranquil water feature and fire pit create the perfect setting for gatherings or quiet evenings. Located on Lot 15 at East Village Leawood, The Caspian is sleek, sophisticated, and thoughtfully designed. This property defines modern luxury living. Read more

items.title: 16979 S Cheshire Street, Olathe, KS 66062
items.description: Stonebridge Villas, Rodrock Development's newest maintenance provided community, presents The Payton Villa RANCH by New Mark Homes. MOVE IN READY!! This 3 bedroom 2.5 bath RANCH home sits on an East backing daylight basement lot! Features a composite, covered deck, enlarged kitchen island, upgraded hardwood flooring, built in cabinets on fireplace wall, tile and light fixture upgrades throughout! HOA covers lawn care, snow removal, clubhouse access, pool, pickleball courts and walking trails. Easy access to major routes for regional commuting. Heritage Park 1.5 mi. Lake Olathe Park 2.0 mi. Hy-Vee 3 mi. Price Chopper 1.5 mi. **Some pictures are of a previous model home. Finishes and Upgrades may vary. Contact agent for details.**

items.title: 12407 W 183rd Terrace, Overland Park, KS 66013
items.description: MODEL HOME- NOT FOR SALE AT THIS TIME. Situated on Lot 52, J.S. Robinson’s Cypress 1.5 floor plan offers a refined 1½-story layout centered around an impressive two-story great room, which is visible from the upper level. The open concept seamlessly integrates the great room, kitchen, dining area, flex room, and outdoor living space. The primary suite serves as a main-level retreat with a luxurious, spa-inspired bath. The upper level features three bedrooms: one with a private en-suite bathroom and two sharing a Jack and Jill bath, each equipped with walk-in closets. Additional living space is provided by a loft that includes a walk-in game closet. Entertaining is enhanced by the covered back patio. This efficient design balances functionality with comfortable and elegant living. Riverstone Valley is close to schools, highways, shops and restaurants! Note: Beginning in the fall of 2026, students in Riverstone Valley will attend the new Blue Valley Middle School: Wolf Springs Middle located at 17501 Grant Street. Read more

FROM THE SITE
What "luxury" means in Kansas City
Luxury real estate here isn't just a price point. It's homes with real architectural character, properties with history, land with development potential, and buyers and sellers who want an agent who understands what makes a property actually stand out, not just what it's listed for. That's the market I work in every day: Mission Hills, Leawood, Prairie Village, Fairway, Overland Park, Brookside, and the wider Kansas City metro on both sides of the state line.
FROM THE SITE
What Makes the Shakespeare Chateau Singular
Most historic homes have been compromised. Original windows replaced. Period details painted over or removed entirely. The Shakespeare Chateau is the exception that makes you realize how rare genuine architectural integrity actually is. 47 original stained-glass windows. Every single one installed in 1885 and still present.
